method.profile: parabolic bowl: depth 0.196 D^1.01 (km) and rim height 0.036 D (Pike 1977); ejecta (r/R)^-3 outside the rim (McGetchin, Settle and Head 1973), cut at 5 R
method.degradation: linear diffusion, kappa 5.5 m2/Myr (Fassett and Thomson 2014), random age 0-3000 Myr per crater
method.sizes: 240 m-2 km, cumulative slope 2.0 (equilibrium of small lunar craters, Minton et al. 2019)
method.density: Robbins (2019) craters >= 1 km in each target map, extrapolated to >= 240 m; a lower bound
method.note: Illustration only: the Earth patch with the target's crater density added. No score uses it.
